_note: Person records behind the voices in the field's cites and the vault's figures (N17a). One record per person; Van Eenwyk is merged (the works voice and the vault figure). Every field is either sourced or blank with a reason; nothing is filled from outside these files. A source is a corpus volume and page (public/data/corpus/<vol>.json, page p), a vault path under the vault root with the quoted phrase, or a repo curation or public/data path with an optional JSON path and quoted phrase. Quoted phrases are checked verbatim by scripts/people-check.mjs. Dates: a year as a number; a day as ISO; an approximate year as 'c. YYEAR' (the source's own 'c.'). subjectKey names the field's subject value (Jung's 82 own-subject occurrences). The Book of Symbols' editors come from curation/symbols/book-of-symbols.json source.editor, checked against the title page (PDF page 7: Editor-in-Chief Ami Ronnberg; Editor Kathleen Martin). Jung's birth is copied from curation/astrology.json people[0] and stays there until the later package moves it.

birth.timeSource: Gret Baumann-Jung, his daughter, who cast his chart (published in Jung on Astrology, 2017). Other records give 19:20 to 19:41, so the rising degree is approximate.
